component.name: Nemesis
component.summary: Lossless music player. Fast, beautiful and lightweight

description.p: Nemesis is a music player designed for lossless audio playback. It supports FLAC, MP3, Opus, and AAC (M4A) formats, as well as CUE files, and offers convenient library browsing by album, artist, track, folder, and playlist. It features a native mode setting that sends audio data to the DAC at the original sample rate and bit depth, bypassing any processing.
The app also supports gapless playback, crossfading, and ReplayGain.
Additional features include lyrics search, downloading, and synchronized display.
It is optimized for instant track searching within the collection and supports system integration via MPRIS media keys, even when minimized.

New "Audio Processing" page: a graphic equalizer with seven presets and a preamplifier. The crossfade function now works in native playback mode as well. Library scanning and album art loading at startup are significantly faster. In addition, numerous fixes have been implemented regarding scrolling, cover art display, and stability.
